text: CALL TO ORDER: 9:42 a.m. Speaker Nunziata took the Chair and called the Members to order. The meeting opened with O Canada. March 25, 2026 Members of Council observed a moment of silence in memory of: Leslie Newton Forbes Shamsh Kara Former City of Toronto Councillor Giorgio Mammoliti Ian Scotty Morrison Edward Pottinger The Honourable Bill Saunderson, the Victims of the Tragedy in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, and the Victims of the Air Canada Plane Crash at LaGuardia Airport, New York Speaker Nunziata addressed Council as follows: I would like to take a moment on behalf of Council to acknowledge the Indigenous Peoples of all the lands that we are on today. We do this to reaffirm our commitment and responsibility in improving relationships between nations and to deepening our own understanding of Indigenous peoples and their cultures.
